description: Source code for handling file transformations and interactions with Vertex AI in a machine learning/AI project, including file upload, JSONL content transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: VertexAIFilesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing Vertex AI file operations, including content extraction, URL generation, and response transformation.

classes.name: VertexAIJsonlFilesTransformation
classes.description: Handles transformation of OpenAI JSONL file content to Vertex AI format, including GCS object naming and content conversion.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up the environment, including API key retrieval and header setup.

methods.name: _get_content_from_openai_file
methods.description: Extracts string content from various file input types.

methods.name: _get_gcs_object_name_from_batch_jsonl
methods.description: Generates a unique GCS object name for batch JSONL files based on model and UUID.

methods.name: get_object_name
methods.description: Determines the object name for file storage, based on content and purpose.

methods.name: get_complete_file_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for uploading files to GCS.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns supported OpenAI parameters for file creation.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps optional parameters for OpenAI to internal format.

methods.name: _map_openai_to_vertex_params
methods.description: Wraps mapping of OpenAI request body parameters to Vertex AI format.

methods.name: _transform_openai_jsonl_content_to_vertex_ai_jsonl_content
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI JSONL content into Vertex AI JSONL format.

methods.name: transform_create_file_request
methods.description: Transforms file creation requests into appropriate formats for Vertex AI, handling batch and non-batch files.

methods.name: transform_create_file_response
methods.description: Converts Vertex AI file upload response into OpenAI-style file object.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns appropriate exception class for errors.
